mapper.sql: id, code, sector_id, relation_level, reason, source, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT ss.code, ss.sector_id AS sectorId, s.category_raw AS categoryRaw, s.category_label AS categoryLabel, s.name, s.topic_id AS topicId, ss.relation_level AS relationLevel, COALESCE(ss.source, s.source) AS source FROM sec_stock_sector ss JOIN sec_sector s ON s.sector_id = ss.sector_id WHERE ss.code = #{code} ORDER BY s.category_raw ASC, s.name ASC
